item.title: UPDATE: Grafton PD arrests wanted man
item.description: The Grafton Police Department has announced the arrest of Todd Matthew Moore, a man wanted since Sunday, who was believed to be armed and dangerous.

item.title: 3 people charged for alleged break-in, assault
item.description: In footage of the incident, troopers saw two women, identified as Cochran and Torres, "in a physical altercation with the victim" during which time, they "bashed the victim's head off of the neighbor's metal door," according to the complaint.

item.title: Man charged after allegedly stealing, totaling Town of Anmoore truck
item.description: A man has been arrested and is facing charges in Braxton County after troopers say he totaled a stolen Town of Anmoore truck in Braxton County before attempting to steal another vehicle.

item.title: Man allegedly pointed gun at Marion County bar employees
item.description: A Fairmont man is facing charges after officers with the White Hall Police Department say he pointed a gun at employees at a White Hall bar.

item.title: Divers help recover car from Monongalia County creek
item.description: Law enforcement is seeking the public's help piecing together how a car wound up in Dunkard Creek in Monongalia County.

item.title: 'Drive to Save Lives Tour' brings road safety message to West Virginia students
item.description: The West Virginia Governor’s Highway Safety Program has announced the “Drive to Save Lives Tour” with international speaker Cara Filler that kicked off Monday.

item.title: Fans show gratitude, pride in the face of WVU's loss to Kentucky
item.description: It wasn't the result that the nearly 13,000 fans at Hope Coliseum wanted, but it's an evening they'll never forget.

item.title: Morgantown high-level drug ring operative gets 20 years in prison
item.description: A Philadelphia man who oversaw the West Virginia branch of a large-scale drug ring that sold methamphetamine, fentanyl and cocaine will spend the next two decades in prison, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) announced Tuesday.
